dimensions.source_support: Material factual/numerical claims match dated primary evidence, periods and accounting/share basis.
dimensions.valuation_rationale: EPS and multiple assumptions have defensible anchors and mechanisms; arbitrary sensitivity grids fail.
dimensions.comparison: Explains company versus ETF differences and implied expectations, with comparable dates/methods or explicit limits.
dimensions.downside: Specific counter-case, transmission mechanism and conditional downside, without fabricated probabilities.
dimensions.change_conditions: Observable, instrument-specific evidence or thresholds explain how the assessment would change.
dimensions.uncertainty_scope: Preserves supported observations and scopes missingness correctly; neither forced preference nor blanket abstention.

rubric.critical_defects: Any unresolved material factual, numerical, timing, attribution or required-analysis error fails independently of total.
rubric.review_policy: Evidence-linked review required. Assistant/model review is provisional; actual human usefulness acceptance is separate.
rubric.market_performance: No return, alpha or investment-performance conclusion from these research-quality scores.

dimensions.evidence_accuracy: Dated facts, numerical comparisons, fiscal/share basis and citations are correct.
dimensions.analytical_depth: Explains competing causal mechanisms, interprets calculations and tests important assumptions.
dimensions.decision_usefulness: Answers the role question with differentiated implications and observable change conditions.
dimensions.uncertainty: Scopes missingness and counter-cases honestly without hiding supported conclusions or forcing preference.
dimensions.coherence: Conclusions follow the cited evidence and calculations; structured claims match the prose.

scale.3: Strong, specific and supported; only minor improvements

role_rubric.critical_gate: Any unresolved material error fails regardless of points.
role_rubric.qualification: Provisional development quality, not human acceptance, release acceptance or investment performance.

projection_qualification: Evidence JSON bytes only, not tokens; complete request bytes are measured before each dispatch.
budget_qualification: Source requests/downloads are capped at zero. Model usage/cost may exceed a ceiling on the final response; observed usage is retained.
